pages.description: A heartwarming scene showing two little puppies hugging a large seated dog appears on this free printable Bluey coloring page. All three characters display happy closed-eye facial expressions set against a simple rectangular backdrop, featuring crisp bold lines that are wonderful to shade using colored pencils.
